description: Safe-edit task type catalog for HoloUtopia citizen purpose queues. Runtime may read this file, but should write task changes only to saves.

wake_up.purpose: Start the citizen daily loop at home.

commute.purpose: Move from home or social locations toward the next scheduled node.

work_shift.purpose: Perform the citizen role/job at an authored work node.

meal_break.purpose: Use a public social/food node and refresh energy.

visit_friend.purpose: Spend time near a known friend or social circle node.

hobby.purpose: Perform a preferred personal activity tied to personality and district.

district_errand.purpose: Run a district support task such as delivery, report, repair check, or supply pickup.

return_home.purpose: Return to assigned residence after work/social activity.

danger_override.purpose: Override the normal schedule and send citizen to a safe node.
